paite: Tapa pil in apa hilhna aza a; himahleh musitmi in asalhna aza kei hi.
Mi'n akam gah in hoih ane ding hi; himahleh lepchiahmi kha in hiamgamna ane ding hi.
Kuapeuh akam veng in ahinna avom a; himahleh kuapeuh amukte hong za in siatna anei ding hi.
Thadah kha in adeih a, bangmah anei kei; himahleh thanuam kha thausak in a-om ding hi.
Midiktat in zuau ahua; himahleh migilou huathuai ahi a, zumna atung sek hi.
Lampi a mitang amah diktatna in aveng; himahleh gitlouhna in mikhial aman hi.
Amah leh amah hausa a kibawl a-om, himahleh bangmah anei kei; amah-le-amah genthei a kibawl a-om, himahleh hauhsakna thupi anei hi.
Mihing hinna tat man ahauhsakna ahi; himahleh genthei in vaulauna aza kei hi.
Midiktat vakna akipak a; himahleh migilou khawnvak akithat ding.
Kisaktheih ziak in kiselna kia ahong a; himahleh hoihtak a thuhilh pilna ahi.
Bangmah lou a hauhsakna muh akiam ding; himahleh sepgimna ziak a lakkhawm apung ding hi.
Lametna halsawt in lungtang achinasak a; himahleh deih ahong tun chiang in, hinna sing ahi.
Kuapeuh thu musit in atung ah asiatna atun hi; himahleh kuapeuh thupiak kihta kipahman piak in a-om ding.
Mipil dan hinna tuikhuk ahi, sihna thangte a kipan a paimangna ding.
Theihsiamna hoih in deihsakna apia a; himahleh lepchiahmi lampi aphok hi.
Mipilvang peuhmah in theihna toh in nna asem a; himahleh mihai in diklouhna athehzak.
Sawltak gilou hoih lou ah apuk a; himahleh palai muanhuai damna ahi.
Gentheihna leh zumna bawlhoihna nial kiang ah a-om dia; himahleh salhna limsak zahtak in a-om ding.
Deih hihpichin kha a ding in anuam a; himahleh gilou a kipan paimang mihaite a ding in kihhuai ahi.
Mipilte toh ton in, huchi in na pil ding; himahleh mihaite kithuahpih in huaiziak in athuak ding.
Hoih lou in mikhialte adelh a; himahleh midiktat hoih a thuk in a-om ding hi.
Mihoih in gouluah ata leh tute kiang ah anutsiat; mikhial hauhsakna midiktat a dia kholkhawm in a-om hi.
Genthei loukhohna ah an tampi a-om; himahleh diklouhna ziak a suksiat a-om hi.
Kuapeuh chiang zang lou in atapa amudah a; himahleh amah it in amah thanuamtak in asawi zel hi.
Midiktat in akha lungkimna tan in ane a; himahleh migilou gilpi atasam ding.
